parent_programmes.relationship: independent stochastic target-generalization audit; no prior result is altered

scientific_question: When positive occurrence evidence leaves multiple stochastic BAM worlds compatible, can the conditional stochastic counterfactual forecast distribution or a coarser decision target nevertheless be identified?

generator_independence.rule: counterfactual forecast targets are generated from NumPy/Python-standard-library code only; EOG is not used to construct target outcomes

frozen_current_runs.landscape: unchanged independent stochastic BAM v3 12x8 landscape
frozen_current_runs.current_evidence: accumulated positive occurrence IDs through horizon 40; unobserved cells are not used as absence evidence for survivor-set construction
frozen_current_runs.forecast_initial_state: the run's observed final occupied snapshot at step 40; this state initializes the counterfactual transition but does not retroactively eliminate candidates by its zero entries

one_step_forecast_contract.purpose: avoid Monte Carlo comparison noise by evaluating the exact conditional one-step transition distribution
one_step_forecast_contract.source_treatment: after the current time, the historical founding source is not forced immortal; it follows the same transformed eligibility and persistence rule as any other occupied node
one_step_forecast_contract.currently_occupied_eligible_node: occupancy probability equals the frozen focal persistence probability 0.86
one_step_forecast_contract.currently_unoccupied_eligible_node: occupancy probability 1-(1-beta)^k with beta=0.48 and k occupied accessible neighbours in the current snapshot
one_step_forecast_contract.conditional_distribution: independent Bernoulli product over nodes given the current snapshot, represented exactly for this audit by the ordered vector of node occupancy probabilities
one_step_forecast_contract.probability_comparison: round each probability to 12 decimal places before equality testing

climate_shift.operator: temperature +0.08 and moisture -0.04 for focal A only; frozen current associate masks and movement parameters retained
climate_shift.decision: expected occupied-node count under the counterfactual is strictly lower than the same world's untransformed one-step expectation by more than 1e-12

biotic_stress.operator: one 4-neighbour erosion of the frozen current partner mask plus one 4-neighbour dilation of the frozen current antagonist mask; same focal A and M
biotic_stress.decision: expected occupied-node count is strictly lower than the same world's untransformed one-step expectation by more than 1e-12

barrier_restoration.operator: force barrier_permeable=true while retaining the same focal A, B, dispersal radius and stochastic demographic parameters
barrier_restoration.decision: expected occupied-node count is strictly higher than the same world's untransformed one-step expectation by more than 1e-12

targets.exact_stochastic_forecast: ordered 96-node conditional occupancy-probability vector under the frozen counterfactual
targets.binary_decision: transformation-specific expected-occupancy decrease/increase relative to the candidate world's own untransformed one-step forecast

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every run and transformation, binary-decision identification is at least as coarse as exact stochastic-forecast identification, which is at least as coarse as parameter-world identification.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is a target-definition or implementation failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For each transformation, at least one run with multiple surviving parameter worlds nevertheless has an identified binary stochastic counterfactual decision.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any transformation without such a run.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For at least one transformation, at least one run with multiple surviving parameter worlds has an identical exact stochastic counterfactual probability vector across all survivors.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no transformation shows this.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For each transformation, at least one nonidentified run contains surviving worlds that disagree on the binary stochastic counterfactual decision.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any transformation without disagreement.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Whenever a target is identified across survivors, the identified exact forecast or binary decision equals the generating truth world's target because the truth world is retained.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any mismatch is an implementation/inference failure.

primary_outputs: parameter-world, exact stochastic forecast and binary decision identification counts across 384 runs
counts by truth scenario and transformation
binary disagreement counts among survivor sets
stop_rules: Do not change the one-step horizon after scoring.
Do not change climate deltas, biotic stress morphology or barrier operator after scoring.
Do not increase stochastic replicate count or select runs based on target results.
Do not use unobserved current cells as absence evidence for survivor-set construction.
Do not interpret one-step synthetic probabilities as calibrated forecasts for a named species.
Do not alter Phase I-V results or the frozen EOG-WF/BAM manuscripts.
candidate_contribution: Extend occurrence-conditioned BAM target identifiability from deterministic counterfactual maps to exact conditional stochastic forecast distributions, separating parameter-world identity, predictive-distribution identity and decision identity under an independently implemented stochastic generator.
